description: This file defines the `Dollar` class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing methods to convert between different dollar formats, such as formatting a number as currency, converting fractional dollar values to decimal, and decimal dollar values into fractions.

classes.name: Dollar
classes.description: Class providing financial dollar conversion methods, including formatting, converting fractional dollar prices to decimal, and vice versa.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number into currency format with specified precision, delegating to Format::DOLLAR.

methods.name: decimal
methods.description: Converts a fractional dollar amount to its decimal equivalent, handling array inputs and validating parameters.

methods.name: fractional
methods.description: Converts a decimal dollar value into a fractional dollar format, handling array inputs and parameter validations.
